# 3.7 Bitmask DP

Phase 3 (Recursion to dynamic programming), target rating 1500–1900. Bank status: short.

## Patterns

### Assign items to slots (`assignment-mask`)

Assign n ≤ about 20 items to n slots; dp over the mask of items already used.

**Works because:** Only the set of used items matters, not the order in which they were used.

### Visit every vertex (`path-mask`)

Shortest or counted Hamiltonian paths with dp[mask][last].

**Works because:** The future depends only on the set of visited vertices and the current vertex.

### Pack items into groups (`group-mask`)

Split items into the fewest groups under a capacity, with dp[mask] = (groups used, fill of the last group).

**Works because:** Groups can be filled in any order, so items can be added one at a time to the last group.

### Iterate over submasks (`submask-mask`)

dp[mask] combines dp of its submasks, O(3^n) in total.

**Works because:** n is at most about 15–18, and the value for a mask depends on a split into a submask and its complement.
